audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: "level chart contradicts data: Vayne wins 52.05% but the chart gives Camille 5/7 stages vs 2". Three rows contradict their own why-text: row 3 reads Skill while whys[3] says your AS spike plus a Condemn on her dash swings trades to you; row 5 reads Skill while whys[5] hands the first-item stage to her Sheen-Q; row 6 reads Camille while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vayne outscales.
audit.why: 52.05% over 1001 games. The packet chart — Camille x3 / Vayne / Camille / Camille / Vayne — is the one that matches the prose already written on the page, including the level 4-5 window mid and spikes[0] both describe.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side and win[3] = Vayne (7/10); phases[5].side and win[5] = Camille (3/10); phases[6].side and win[6] = Vayne (8/10). Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 already read Camille and are left alone.
sources: brief currentText content whys[3], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.why: The spike windows named are the right ones — Camille's level 1-3 dominance, her Sheen-Q first item, Vayne's 4-5 attack-speed window and the two-item flip. Added the numbers that make them actionable: Hookshot 16/15/14/13/12s, Tactical Sweep 15s at rank 1, The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90s, Condemn 20s at rank 1, Final Hour 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Hookshot 16s at rank 1 stated in phases[3].why as the window your 4-5 spike is fought in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields (whys[0], spikes[0], spikes[2], early, wants.foe[0]) attribute Camille's true damage to her E. Her true damage is on Precision Protocol (Q); Hookshot (E) is the wall-dash that knocks up. The passive shield was also miscredited to E in spikes[2]. Two applicable interactions were absent: Tactical Sweep (W) heals her off the outer half of the cone, and her combo opens on the Precision Protocol auto-reset.
audit.why: Filing the true damage on E tells the player that dodging the dash removes the damage — it does not. The Q is what hurts, and the reset animation on it is the tell that the combo is starting. The W healing is what makes extended trades hers and it decides when Executioner's Calling is bought.
audit.corrected: Precision Protocol (Q) double-cast carries the true damage and resets her auto; Hookshot (E) is the 16s wall-dash knock-up Condemn is held for; Tactical Sweep (W) heals off the outer cone; Adaptive Defenses is the damage-typed passive shield.
